answer: Opal-reef crystal receipts: each agent transaction emits a signed crystal (hash-linked receipt) anchored to a shared opal-reef ledger. To spawn a clone, the operator must present a fresh crystal lineage; the ledger rejects any lineage lacking a verified opal seed, and issuing one requires a paid reef slot that decays unless the agent completes real work. Cloning thus costs a decaying slot plus lost work credit per identity, while honest agents earn slot renewals, making honesty cheaper.
